name: parry-core
description: PARRY CORE - a one-thumb radial parry arcade roguelite for iOS and Android.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run audit
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync && node tools/prepare-native.mjs
scripts.native:add:android: npm run build && cap add android && node tools/prepare-native.mjs
scripts.native:add:ios: npm run build && cap add ios && node tools/prepare-native.mjs
scripts.native:open:android: npm run cap:sync && cap open android
scripts.native:open:ios: npm run cap:sync && cap open ios
